pr_title: Fixed an exception while writing some paths on the address bar
pr_body:
**Resolved / Related Issues**
- Closes #5459

**Details of Changes**
- Added a return when the parentFolder is null. This fixes the exception of #5459, though the other issue is not solved, so it seems that after all it was caused for some other reason. 
This exception has been happening to me when writing any path on the address bar from some time ago while debugging. 

**Validation**
How did you test these changes?
- [x] Built and ran the app
- [ ] Tested the changes for accessibility

issue_context.title: Error on VS while writing "Home" in address bar
issue_context.body:
<!-- 
🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨
I ACKNOWLEDGE THE FOLLOWING BEFORE PROCEEDING:
1. Issue may be deleted if it is not following the template
2. Only post one issue per one bug report
3. Try not to make duplicates. Do a quick search before posting
4. Add a title that describes the issue clearly
--->

**Explain the bug**
While testing my implementation of translation of "Home" in the addess bar (#5441) I've found this bug that in the beginning I thought it was caused by my solution, but after that I check that is happening also on main.

The easy way to check this bug is withing VS, but you can check on Files too because in the address bar it will still show "Home" even if you are on another directory.

**To reproduce**
1. Go to a directory, like Documents.
2. Click on Address bar and write Home
3. If you are debugging with VS, it will show you the error. If not, you can easily check doing those extra steps:
4. After forcing the error, go again to the same directory of the step 1. This is important, if you go to another it will not work the next step.
5. Click on Address bar and it will show "Home" instead the actual directory.

**Expected behavior**
It should not throw an error on VS, and it should show the actual directory instead "Home" again.

**Logfile**
[debug_fulltrust.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6849580/debug_fulltrust.log)
[debug.log](https://github.com/files-community/Files/files/6849581/debug.log)

**Screenshots**
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11770760/126352560-01439c40-ab4e-413a-9ddb-c36d39eb1d4f.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11770760/126353221-715589c6-3586-455e-8f6e-0714cd76d03d.png)

**System Information**
 - OS Version: Windows 10 Pro 21H1 19043.1081 / Windows Feature Experience Pack 120.2212.3530.0
- App version: Last main commit.

**Additional comment**
This problem still happen after restarting the app.

review_comments: I'd revert this change as there is nothing particularly evil about that exception. The exception in related to the address bar suggestions, not really to the addressbar text and is used to show the "No suggestions" message below the box. There may be nicer ways to do this but the exception does its job.

I can revert it if you want, but I didn't see any difference on the adress bar suggestions after this change. The "no suggestions" is still working as expected. The only change I saw is that every time I write a letter on the address bar debugging won't get stopped by that exception.

I will test now your added commit.
It works because a different exception (ArgumentNullException) is thrown on the next line :)  Anyway on second thought this is a fine change 👍

Aaah, okay!

Thanks, I appreciate it, it was very annoying for me that exception 😢
